create_Env: create a humanoid simulation environment by instantiating Env with a config dict specifying character URDF, physics params, and ground settings
step_simulation: step the simulation forward one control timestep by calling env.step with an optional list of action dicts for each agent
reset_environment: reset the simulation to initial state by calling env.reset with optional time, poses, velocities, or a saved pybullet state ID
check_falldown: check if an agent has fallen by calling env.check_falldown with the agent index, using either collision-based or height-based detection methods
get_ground_height: get the ground height at an agent position by calling env.get_ground_height with the agent index, supporting height maps and raycasting
